#comment: The following are CMOR internal settings and should not be edited by the user
comment: The complete source rectangle is retained. The two files contain cumulative stocks for overlapping 0-30 cm and 0-100 cm depth intervals and must not be summed.
contact: Zhuonan Wang (zzw0034@auburn.edu, zw5@ornl.gov); Jitendra Kumar (kumarj@ornl.gov); Debjani Sihi (dsihi@ncsu.edu)
grid: Original data-provider 30 arc-second latitude-longitude grid; values retained without resampling.

references: Wang, Z., Kumar, J., Weintraub-Leff, S. R., Todd-Brown, K., Mishra, U., & Sihi, D. (2024). Upscaling soil organic carbon measurements at the continental scale using multivariate clustering analysis and machine learning. Journal of Geophysical Research: Biogeosciences, 129, e2023JG007702. https://doi.org/10.1029/2023JG007702
title: AI-upscaling-cSoil 1 (2024): Upscaling soil organic carbon measurements at the continental scale using multivariate clustering analysis and machine learning
variant_info: Prepared at ORNL from the original Zenodo SOC mean rasters.
originData_notes: The 0-30 cm and 0-100 cm SOC mean GeoTIFFs were retrieved. Coefficient-of-variation rasters are outside the scope of this contribution.
